overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-8): 'Purchase of furniture, equipment and leasehold improvements, net of disposals' $(72,178) thousand for FY2025, with $(91,509) thousand for FY2024 and $(67,183) thousand for FY2023 in the same statement
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex - capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads; the filer's own cash-flow statement reports this capex line for all three years. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; the FY2023/FY2024 filing values in the same statement ($67.183M / $91.509M) are the same magnitude, and capex at this level is immaterial against OCF in the billions (under ~3% of conservative OE in each of the last 3 FY).

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), Consolidated Balance Sheets (p. F-4), Stockholders' Equity section: Class A common stock 218,465,429 shares, non-voting common stock 3,489,911 shares, Class B common stock 1,000 shares, and Class C common stock 105,079,121 shares, each stated as issued and outstanding as of December 31, 2025 - total 327,035,461 shares
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares - diluted/total shares missing for FY2025 in EDGAR companyfacts (the filer tags share counts by class and the aggregated facts drop them). The engine's denominator basis in every prior year is total shares outstanding across all classes (FY2024: the same balance-sheet four-class sum is 199,872,571 + 3,489,911 + 1,000 + 109,806,689 = 313,170,171, exactly the engine's filed FY2024 count), so the FY2025 total on the identical basis fills the gap without changing the per-share basis. The Class A-only weighted diluted count in the same filing (217,361,945) is NOT used, because it is on a different, narrower basis than every prior year in the engine history.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.5%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
